title: Seoul ⇄ Busan
subtitle: a journey for two, one place at a time
budgetLine: Every restaurant here stays under ≈₩38,000 (≈€23–25) per person for food.

h1.title: 57 Myeongdong Hostel
h1.name: 57 Myeongdong Hostel
h1.about: A small, well-rated hostel in the middle of Myeongdong — a short walk from the Namsan cable car and the evening street-food stalls.

h2.title: Haru Forest Hotel Seongsu & Konkuk
h2.name: 하루포레스트호텔 성수&건대점
h2.about: Your base for two nights in Seongsu–Konkuk (광진구 화양동 23-21), about 5 min on foot from Konkuk Univ. station — the east-side neighbourhood of converted factories, bakeries and the Common Ground container mall.
h2.hours: Korean listings show overnight check-in 20:00 · checkout 13:00
h2.warn: Confirm the check-in time with the hotel and ask to drop bags at 11:30.

h3.title: Hotel Aqua Palace
h3.name: Hotel Aqua Palace
h3.about: A Gwangalli beachfront hotel with a Korean bathhouse; the 21st-floor deck faces the Gwangan Bridge.

h4.title: glue hotel
h4.name: glue hotel
h4.about: A design hotel at 228 Yulgok-ro, Jongno, at the foot of Naksan — theatre district by day, fortress wall by night. Live music in the lounge ≈20:00–22:00.

tips.p: Some stops are a choice: dashed cards with 2–4 options. Tap an option to preview it, then press ♥ Киця's pick to make it hers — the pick is marked with a heart and her name, and the directions to the next stop start from it. Skip marks a stop you'd rather leave out; it drops out of the map and the itinerary. Meal choices have a small ginkgo-yellow dot.
With live sync on (⋯ → Sync between phones), hearts, skips, ticks and the final approval appear on both phones within a second and survive reloads. Without it, each phone keeps its own copy.
Open ♥ Our picks to see what's decided. Once Киця approves, export the chosen stops as a Google My Maps file, or open the illustrated itinerary to save it as a PDF or send it by email.
T-money card from any convenience store: ≈₩1,550 per metro ride in Seoul. For taxis use Kakao T or Uber; fares here are per car, and rise 20–40% after 22:00.
Walking and taxi times are computed from real road routes at a relaxed pace; rush hour (08–09:30, 18–19:30) adds 10–15 min to taxi legs.

Your Busan nights are Mon–Thu, so you miss Busan's Saturday drone show and the 7 Nov fireworks — but you get Seoul's Hangang drone-show finale on Sat 31 Oct, and the Gwangan Bridge is lit every night.
Google Maps is fine for metro and bus routes, but weak for walking. Use the Naver button for walking directions and exact station exits.
Prices and hours are approximate (autumn 2026). Every restaurant here stays under ≈₩38,000 (≈€23–25) per person for food; drinks are extra.
